data.body: ADR numbering note (2026-09-07): the number 0117 in this story is a PLACEHOLDER. Task arterial-bilineate-vampirebat (a01e-01e7-6e6e-4809, "land ADR 0117 recording Windows as a declared support target") is open and ready and will take 0117 if it lands first; `scripts/check_adr_numbers.py` enforces a bijection, so a clash fails CI. At landing, take the next free number (`ls docs/adr/.numbers | sort | tail -1`, plus one) and substitute it everywhere this story writes it (`docs/adr/<n>-cli-verb-consolidation.md`, `docs/adr/.numbers/<n>`, the `docs/api-stability.md:22` sentence, release notes). The same rule applies to the MCP epic's ADR (placeholder 0118) and the docs epic's consolidated reconciler record (placeholder 0119); those two land after this one, so their numbers shift by the same offset.
